robot.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: weapon and combat VFX concept sheet for an existing third-person sci-fi mecha game.
Primary request: compelling weapon designs and attack effects for a white humanoid combat robot, with readable animation timing and physical weapon construction.
Subject: the SAME original angular white-and-graphite humanoid mecha in all panels: narrow mechanical waist, exposed dark articulated joints, tapered armored limbs, swept shoulder/back fins, small red-orange optics and chest core. Sophisticated sculptable construction, convincing weight and planted feet, no copied franchise markings.
Composition: premium wide landscape art-direction board with three clearly separated columns. Each column contains a prominent weapon design close-up, one large full-body attack keyframe, and three small left-to-right timing studies along the bottom. Neutral charcoal background with a simple dark ground plane, crisp edges, no distracting scenery.
Column 1 "BEAM SABER": engineered handheld emitter with protective guard and replaceable energy cell; focused luminous magenta blade with white-hot core, translucent curved slash ribbon that follows the true blade arc, short sparks only at contact, one glowing cut on a dark target plate. Full-body pose has a planted lead foot, torso rotation and extended sword arm; bottom studies show coiled windup, decisive slash, controlled follow-through. No sword trail covering the whole robot.
Column 2 "PULSE CANNON": substantial forearm-mounted or handheld cannon with layered white armor shroud, dark barrel, cooling vents and luminous cyan capacitor elements; concentrated blue-white muzzle flash, segmented bolt path, compact circular shock front at muzzle, hard target impact with electric fragments and dust. Robot shoulders and arm show recoil and recovery; bottom studies show capacitor charge, brief discharge, recoil settling.
Column 3 "MISSILE SALVO": compact armored back-mounted missile pods with hinged doors and individual missile rails, three clearly distinct missiles with bright amber exhaust, thin turbulent smoke trails curving toward separate targets, one readable impact explosion with hot core and dark rolling debris. Small keyframes show doors opening, staggered launch and impact, with robot balancing against launch impulse.
Style/medium: high-end realistic game concept illustration and practical VFX design, polished material rendering, clear metal/ceramic/rubber distinctions, impressive restrained effects. Consistent robot silhouette and weapon construction across views. No low-poly placeholders.
Text: only "BEAM SABER", "PULSE CANNON", "MISSILE SALVO" at column tops; short bottom sequence labels "WINDUP", "STRIKE", "RECOVERY" for saber, "CHARGE", "FIRE", "RECOVERY" for cannon, "OPEN", "LAUNCH", "IMPACT" for missiles. No fake technical paragraphs, watermark or logos.
Constraints: concept sheet for future implementation, not an actual gameplay screenshot. Preserve silhouette readability and make effect origin, trajectory and hit location obvious. No gore.

monsters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: monster attack animation and VFX production concept sheet for a sci-fi mecha game.
Primary request: show impressive, readable monster weapon/attack effects with strong anticipation and believable motion, matching a dark alien ecosystem of basalt-like chitin armor, exposed flexible tendons and restrained glowing attack organs.
Composition: high-resolution wide landscape professional board with FIVE horizontal rows and THREE clear columns titled "WINDUP", "ATTACK", "IMPACT". Clean muted charcoal-gray background and a simple ground plane in each panel. Every row shows the SAME creature and continuous attack direction left to right; leave clear separation between panels. Keep creatures recognizable and fully framed, effects localized. Include a small white humanoid mecha target silhouette where useful for scale, without gore.
Row 1 "HUNTER": lean cyan-eyed six-limbed insect predator with split mandibles and spring-loaded hind legs. Windup: deep compressed crouch with rear feet firmly planted. Attack: explosive pounce with foreclaw arc and a narrow cyan acid spray from mandibles. Impact: claws scrape sparks on a mech armor shield and acid splashes into a small cyan sizzling ground patch. Thin motion arcs, no giant explosion.
Row 2 "CHARGER": broad four-legged siege beast, heavy wedge horned head, amber warning organs, layered chipped mineral armor. Windup: lowered head, compressed rear legs, shoulders rising and a clear amber ground-direction cue. Attack: powerful forward charge with alternating foot contact and a dust wake. Impact: concentrated ground fracture fan, coarse fragments and a pressure ring from the horn strike; weight carried into the forequarters.
Row 3 "SPORE ARTILLERY": six-legged crab-spider with translucent olive-green pressure sacs and an anatomical dorsal mortar organ. Windup: legs spread and anchor, sacs inflate and glow. Attack: dorsal organ contracts to lob a few distinct glowing green globes along a readable ballistic arc. Impact: one ruptured spore creates a contained green corrosive puddle, droplets, low vapor and clear circular danger boundary; avoid a whole-screen cloud.
Row 4 "BROOD LORD": tall arthropod with two huge forearms, four supporting legs, crown-shaped armor ridge and red-orange thoracic organ. Windup: torso coils and one forearm lifts with orange chest pulse. Attack: broad sweeping strike or two-arm ground slam with a clear trail attached to the moving limb. Impact: expanding low orange shockwave ring, radial ground cracks and debris; show a useful gap above the low ring for player readability.
Row 5 "VOID LEVIATHAN": colossal long-bodied, six-limbed boundary guardian with eroded basalt armor, recessed amber eyes, interlocking mandibles and a white-hot throat; tiny mech silhouettes emphasize immense size. Windup: firmly planted limbs, head tracks the target, throat core charges. Attack: tightly focused amber-white energy beam from the throat, compressed luminous rings along the beam, glowing eyes. Impact: vertical plume of dust, molten sparks and a bright ground scar at the targeted point, not a wall of featureless light.
Style/medium: premium realistic creature and effects concept painting, sculptable anatomy, clear material texture, cinematic but highly legible effect shapes, consistent color language by enemy class.
Text: only the five short creature names and three column labels. No dense text, UI overlays, brand logos or watermark.
Constraints: this is concept art for future Blender models and game effects. Show cause and effect, stable supports, energy buildup before impact, distinct attack signatures, no gore or dismemberment.
